responsibility: Defines the target-specific RTL predicates used by Visium machine patterns to classify operands and comparison operators. It recognizes Visium-specific register kinds, constants, add-immediate forms, non-EAM operands, FP operands, and the legal comparison sets for the backend’s custom condition-code modes and branch/cstore patterns, thereby supplying the semantic operand tests referenced throughout visium.md pattern matching and splitting.
